meaning.en: Shining with the goad that is anger itself

explanation.en: In another hand she holds an aṅkuśa, the goad used to guide an elephant, and it shines. The name says this goad is krodha, anger.

inner.en: The goad is anger, the force that drives and restrains. Held by her, anger becomes discipline turned against our own faults, steering the mind back to the path.

story.en: Names 8 to 11 describe her four emblems: noose, goad, sugarcane bow and flower-arrows. This is the form in which she is worshipped in Śrīvidyā.
